playstyle: Versatile mid-range control. Hold the mid range with solid, tracking pokes, close the gap with his loopable Shadow Sprint and crouch step, and mix up from back-turned (BT) and Soulzone (SZN). Wavu notes his lows are reactable or low damage, so most of your damage comes from mids, counter hits and punishes.

stances.name: Labyrinth / Back-turned
stances.entry: b+3+4, and moves that leave him back-turned
stances.note: BT.4 is a Heat Engager; BT.b+3 is a homing high, +4 on block.

stances.name: Soulzone
stances.note: SZN.2 is a Heat Engager; SZN.1+2 is homing, +0 to +1 on block, and launches on counter hit.

stances.name: Crouch Dash
stances.note: His crouch step: qcf+4 tornadoes, qcf+2~1 is safe.

keyMoves: i10 jab string, -3 on block, can enter SZN with 3+4.
